name: Issue 1505 official Codex and Desktop path control

on:
  push:
    branches: [ops/1505-smoke-github-readonly-20261109]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/issue1505-official-path-control.yml
      - scripts/ops/issue1505-official-path-control.py
      - scripts/ops/issue1505-official-path-control.test.py

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: issue1505-official-path-control
  cancel-in-progress: false
  queue: max

jobs:
  observe:
    # Root-reviewed single official-only diagnostic window; attempt 1 only.
    if: github.repository == 'alexj11324/Mikka' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/ops/1505-smoke-github-readonly-20261109' && github.run_attempt == 1
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Observation remains 900s; this ceiling leaves the 150s cleanup-only recheck.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
      CONTROL_GO: 'root-reviewed-1505-official-path-control-20261109-v1'
      CONTROL_NOT_BEFORE: 2026-11-09T18:01:26Z
      CONTROL_DEADLINE: 2026-11-09T18:16:26Z
    steps:
      - name: Check out the fixed product source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: 5ba1f9e2359ce714d83cd16fc040f2567c40a6d0
          path: source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this diagnostic revision
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: ops
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify offline source and ownership guards
        run: |
          python3 -B ops/scripts/ops/issue1505-official-path-control.test.py
          python3 -B ops/scripts/ops/issue1505-official-path-control.py verify --source source --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue1505-official-path-control"
      - name: Install only the pinned control SDK
        run: |
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue1505-official-path-sdk"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue1505-official-path-sdk/bin/pip" install --disable-pip-version-check 'e2b==2.62.0'
      - name: Recheck absolute budget before requesting the key
        run: python3 -B ops/scripts/ops/issue1505-official-path-control.py verify --source source --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue1505-official-path-control"
      - name: Read only the existing E2B key
        id: key
        uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod
          secret-path: /vercel
          secret-name: E2B_API_KEY
          include-imports: false
      - name: Observe only fixed Desktop APT and Codex root CA metadata
        run: >-
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue1505-official-path-sdk/bin/python" -B ops/scripts/ops/issue1505-official-path-control.py diagnose
          --source source --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue1505-official-path-control"
      - name: Recheck exact owned instances and private templates
        if: always() && steps.key.outcome == 'success'
        timeout-minutes: 3
        run: >-
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue1505-official-path-sdk/bin/python" -B ops/scripts/ops/issue1505-official-path-control.py cleanup
          --source source --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/issue1505-official-path-control"
      - name: Preserve closed observations and cleanup receipts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: issue1505-official-path-control-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/issue1505-official-path-control/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

localValidation.scope: same 36 offline tests against the actual bound workflow; no provider or credentials

windowRebinding.reason: never activated local window expired during compaction; only two UTC literals changed
